senses.gloss: c. (= גּוּדָּא; גוד or גדד, v. גְּדוּד I) a band, troop.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 86a:8">B. Mets. 86ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ דפרשי</he> a troop of horsemen.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11a:4">Ab. Zar. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ דרומאי</he> a troop of Roman (soldiers). [<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>הדר שדר גונדאי דרומאי וכ׳</he>, read with Ms. M. <he>גונדא אחרינא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).
<cite ref="Nedarim 32a:4">Ned. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ דחימה</he> the troop commanded by Ḥemah (angel of wrath).—Pl. <he>גּוּנְדֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 60a">Ḥull. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>דנפישי ג׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>חילותיה</he>) His armies are too numerous.
